host: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X, 8 physical cores, 16 hardware threads; concurrent unrelated workloads.

method.paired: Alternating previous and release compiler, fresh process from session open to finished Wasm, default frontend worker policy. Main has 271 source modules. Filesystem data warm except for disk series. Profile runs separate. Check in parallel mode includes worker-side lowering.
method.disk: Private copies of compiler, source, standard library and assets evicted before each run. mincore confirmed residency zero. System libraries and directory metadata may stay warm. A second eight-pair series reversed the starting order.
method.micro: One source module with no prelude, using a constant entry that returns 42. Full builds instantiate Wasm and read the returned global. Separate check-project runs capture inference before ownership analysis. Synthetic single-process timings vary with host load. Rerun deno run -A benchmarks/tools/bench_type_scaling.ts <compiler>.
method.cpu: 1 ms process CPU timer. Four fresh serial Main comparisons with the owner-index-only candidate. Composition sampled on the baseline CLI build for 1.5 s before cancelling.
